query:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY device_id, location_name
            ORDER BY timestamp DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM iot_data_s
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY device_id, location_name;
